name: Red Lilies
source:
Irene is a young woman who is sent far away from her London home to attend Lady Lilianne’s Academy in the countryside. This school is lovely and has everything a young woman about to enter society could ask for: a strong emphasis on etiquette, her every need attended to by maids, gardens for fresh air and peaceful walks, other beautiful young women to be her bosom buddy as they brave the unknown together…

[i][b]And it’s far out into the countryside, away from the smoke and fog, far away from the cities.[/b][/i]

When a horrific tragedy strikes the school just a day after Irene’s arrival, she and her new friends are terrified of who will be next. Because others [i]will[/i] be next.

And with the headmistress not believing them, the doors locked at night, and no one around to help for miles, the girls are on their own…

[From [url=https://krispycat.itch.io/red-lilies]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
艾琳被送离伦敦的家乡，前往乡间的莉莉安女士学院就读。这里美丽宜人，具备一位即将步入社交界的年轻女子所能期盼的一切：重视礼仪，女仆照料她的各种需求，花园供人呼吸新鲜空气、安静散步，还有其他美丽的年轻女子可以与她亲密结伴，共同面对未知……

[i][b]而且学院位于遥远的乡间，远离烟雾与雾霾，也远离城市。[/b][/i]

艾琳抵达学校仅一天，便发生了一场可怕的悲剧。她和新朋友们都害怕下一个受害者会是谁，因为其他人[i]也会[/i]成为下一个受害者。

校长不相信她们，夜晚大门紧锁，周围数英里都没有人能帮忙，女孩们只能靠自己……

[摘自[url=https://krispycat.itch.io/red-lilies]Itch.io[/url]]
